page.layout: One page of text, single column of verse, centred; a rule and a centred heading "EIDEM." below the first stanza group; faint show-through from the reverse page at right margin (not transcribed).

main_text.l: Sic dura cunctis sospes ab hostibus
Te rege tuti rura ferat labor
Rex maior, uno rite minor Deo.
main_text.head: EIDEM.

page.notes: Verse printed as lines; line-initial letters in the printed text such as "Pœna" and "Sic" follow the original. Some words are doubtful in the faint scan: "vaganti" (possibly vagantì), "Faustitáque" and "Luratas" are uncertain. Show-through from the reverse page appears at right and is omitted.
